business_problem: General Assembly needed a more consistent and reliable way to plan, budget, report, and reconcile global marketing spend because spreadsheets, inconsistent taxonomies, and manual coordination across more than 45 agencies were slowing decisions and limiting financial control.
solution_summary: General Assembly worked with MINT and IBM to replace fragmented marketing-financial operations with a governed AI planning stack built on IBM watsonx.ai. The first step was a unified data model with standardized taxonomies and definitions across regions, channels, and business lines, eliminating the inconsistent local structures that had made comparisons unreliable. On top of that foundation, MINT implemented agentic AI workflows with watsonx.ai for media planning, budget pacing, scenario-based forecasting, and automated reporting and reconciliation. These governed workflows replaced spreadsheet-heavy manual coordination and created a single operational view of global budget status, enabling teams to spot risks, forecast outcomes, and react earlier. Because the system combines shared definitions, automation, and AI-assisted decision support, General Assembly can now scale marketing investment and evaluate performance globally without adding the same level of manual planning overhead.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Powers the agentic AI workflows used for planning, forecasting, budget pacing, and reporting across global marketing operations.

data_flow: Regional marketing and financial data is normalized into a unified model, watsonx.ai applies AI-assisted planning and forecasting workflows against that governed dataset, and the resulting budget and performance views feed global reporting, pacing, and reconciliation decisions.
business_outcome: General Assembly gained a unified financial view of global marketing activity, reduced planning and reporting effort, and increased confidence and speed in budget and pacing decisions.
metrics: 20% time savings in planning and reporting
100% visibility into global budget and pacing
1 unified data model replacing regional taxonomies
architecture_clues: The solution uses a unified data model with standardized taxonomies across regions and business lines.
Agentic AI supports media planning, scenario forecasting, and proactive budget pacing.
The design is explicitly governed and enterprise-ready rather than a standalone AI pilot.
